reviewed_contracts: Default executes neither observation nor WSL. Windows path uses exact pinned API80, bounded process enumeration, retained QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION plus SYNCHRONIZE handles, birth/wait identity, and closes queried handles.
Unreadable Windows counters and unknown wait outcomes remain qualified. Global commit, per-process private commit and working sets are not equated.

Linux observation uses its own ten-second alarm, eight-second process-loop bound, maximum4096 process/error rows and bounded pseudo-file reads; it records memory/process/cgroup counters without cmdline/environment or runtime payload reads.

No subprocess, fork, signals to other processes, cache reclamation, installation, mount or configuration change is present. Linux CLI must run in a separate retained owner/client process under the original lock, avoiding another owner's alarm context.
Counters are observations. The source does not establish historical causality, scientific acceptance or earlier lost native closure.
